# m.economy.inflation_expectations

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

US inflation expectations from market prices and models, one row per day.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.economy.inflation_expectations(*, start=None, end=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

- [Query methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `Date`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows its rule under [shared arguments](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`start`](README.md#start) | The first date; a calendar date only. |
| [`end`](README.md#end) | The last date, inclusive; None also returns rows dated in the future. |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | Massive's field to sort by, such as `"date"`. Fields: any REST field under [Massive fields](#massive-fields). |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The direction of `sort`; it needs `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The total-row cap. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Further endpoint parameters. Keys: none. |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Date` | String | Calendar date of the observation (YYYY‑MM‑DD). |
| `ForwardYears5To10` | double | 5-Year, 5-Year Forward Inflation Expectation Rate — the market's expectation of average annual inflation for the 5-year period beginning 5 years from now, based on the spread between forward nominal and real yields. |
| `Market10Year` | double | 10-Year Breakeven Inflation Rate — the market's expectation of average annual inflation over the next 10 years, based on the spread between 10-year nominal Treasury yields and 10-year TIPS yields. |
| `Market5Year` | double | 5-Year Breakeven Inflation Rate — the market's expectation of average annual inflation over the next 5 years, based on the spread between 5-year nominal Treasury yields and 5-year TIPS yields. |
| `Model10Year` | double | The Cleveland Fed’s 10-year inflation expectations data estimated expected inflation, risk premiums, and the real interest rate using a model based on Treasury yields, inflation data, swaps, and surveys. |
| `Model1Year` | double | The Cleveland Fed’s 1-year inflation expectations data estimated expected inflation, risk premiums, and the real interest rate using a model based on Treasury yields, inflation data, swaps, and surveys. |
| `Model30Year` | double | The Cleveland Fed’s 30-year inflation expectations data estimated expected inflation, risk premiums, and the real interest rate using a model based on Treasury yields, inflation data, swaps, and surveys. |
| `Model5Year` | double | The Cleveland Fed’s 5-year inflation expectations data estimated expected inflation, risk premiums, and the real interest rate using a model based on Treasury yields, inflation data, swaps, and surveys. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together share it. It isn't Massive's time, and later rows can carry earlier times. In a `poll()` table, it's the time of the poll the row's values came from. |
